videos.title: 10 Days South Africa
videos.description: Travelxp presents an amazing series about traveling to fantastic exotic destinations. This time the host of the show Alex Outhwaite is visiting South Africa, where she spends 10 days and gets the best glimpse of this mysterious country, home of incredible people, stunning sights and unbelievable animals. Look close at the jungle cats, go cage diving with sharks, enjoy a relaxing spa treatment while watching hippos. Adrenaline buzz provided by the host makes sure you get the best of your vacation to South Africa. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Best From the Rest
videos.description: In our fast-moving world even on a holiday we are always short of time and in a rush. Best From the Rest on TravelXP will filter the information to save you every single minute so that you won't miss a thing. The show highlights top five places or activities that deserve your full attention in various cities all over the world. From top 5 romantic places in Mauritius, 5 best things to do when in Dubai, to 5 must see destinations in Hong Kong, 5 most sacred temples in the state of Rajasthan and 5 new adventures in Jordan. Every signature episode will take your breath away. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Landmarks
videos.description: Landmarks is a documentary series that celebrates wonderful sites from all around the world that have great cultural and historical significance. From natural beauties to monuments raised in remembrance of important historical figures, from architectural wonders to religious sites, these are some of the world's most amazing landmarks. Discover the stories behind them and find out more about their importance, both in the past and in the present day, including sites like the Buckingham Palace, the Dead Sea and the Burj Khalifa skyscraper in Dubai. (Senderinfo).
